TA sub-role URI is membership/Instructor#TeachingAssistant; platforms should also send the principal role
Security Framework 1.0 requires third-party-initiated login, a nonce in the id_token, kid always set, and RS256 minimum
NRPS 2.0 requires only user_id and roles; 'LTI does not pass user information in its default configuration'
AGS 2.0: the platform MAY ignore scores that are not FullyGraded and 'has the final say' on final scores; the comment field is visible to students
Dynamic Registration 1.0 is Candidate Final; a new registration is 'not activated yet' until an admin activates it
Brightspace supports LTI 1.3 core, AGS v2.0, NRPS v2.0 and Deep Linking 2.0
Registering a tool needs the org-level 'Manage LTI Tools' permission; Dynamic Registration is disabled by default; redirect URLs must match exactly; a domain can be in only one enabled registration
The Brightspace deployment 'Anonymous' property was removed (LE API v1.92) and 'is always considered to be false' as of LMS 20.26.2 (re-checked this run). The KB article still mentions Anonymous
SendInstitutionRole is a registration property, not a deployment flag (correction made this run)
PreProvisioning is a 'Security setting to send classlist including users not known to tool'
UW's actual LEARN-to-IMS role mapping (for example for TAs)
LEARN is D2L-hosted; the LEARN team reviews third-party tools with the Privacy Officer and ISO before integration; the standard data set is USERID/role/username/email
UW IRA-PIA review 'typically takes 2–4 weeks'; FIPPA amended by Bill 194, effective 1 Jul 2025
UW LEO handles 'requests for integration with the LMS'; principles include 'sustainable' and 'scalable … broad campus use'; the CIO approves contracts
UW guidance: without proper permission, instructors 'are not authorized to release student information' (page dated July 2017)
UW guidance: 'best to choose a tool that does not require students to identify themselves'; check whether an IRA is required first
jose 6.2.12, MIT, zero dependencies, repo pushed 2026-10-01

The saLTIre Test Platform supports LTI 1.3, Deep Linking, a line-item service and Dynamic Registration with no account needed; NRPS support is not stated
moodle-docker (GPL-3.0) exists and is maintained; Moodle registers LTI Advantage tools pending-then-activate
1EdTech certification needs active membership; price not listed
Brightspace grade import CSV needs OrgDefinedID or Username plus an End-of-Line Indicator

other-O1-email-notifications.claim: SES has no SES-specific free allowance. À la carte outbound costs $0.10 per 1,000. New AWS customers get up to $200 in Free Tier credits.
SES sandbox sends only to verified recipients, at most 200 messages per 24 hours and 1 per second, per Region. AWS Support gives an initial response to production-access requests within 24 hours.
SES is available in ca-central-1 and ca-west-1. SMTP endpoints are not available in ca-west-1.
SES open and click tracking only happens when a configuration set with an event destination is set up. ses:no-track disables tracking per link.
SES does not retain message bodies (no official page states this either way).
Resend Free allows 3,000 emails/month, is limited to 100 per day, and has 30-day data retention. Pro costs $20/month for 50,000.
All Resend account data, including email metadata and logs, is stored in the United States. No Canadian region exists.
Resend turns off message content storage only via support, on Pro/Scale with conditions, as a $50/month add-on.
Cloudflare Email Sending is in Beta and available on Workers Paid. It includes 3,000 emails/month, then $0.35 per 1,000.
Cloudflare Email preview keeps HTML, text, headers and raw source for about seven days and is on by default for new sending domains.
Postmark Free is 100 emails/month and Basic is $15/month. Postmark keeps content and metadata for 45 days and is hosted in the US with no EU plans.
Mailgun Free is 100 emails/day with 1 custom domain and 1-day log retention. Basic is $15/month.
SendGrid offers a free trial of 100 emails/day for 60 days; the page still mentions a 'free plan' elsewhere. Essentials starts at $19.95/month.
MailerSend Free is 500 emails/month with 100 daily requests and requires approval and a card. Hobby is $7/month for 5,000.
Brevo free-plan limits, data location and DPA
Exchange Online message trace shows sender, recipient and the first 256 characters of the subject for up to 90 days.
Safe Links click data (UrlClickEvents) stores the full clicked URL plus AccountUpn, timestamp and IP. Whether UW licenses Defender for Office 365 is unknown.
From 2025-05-05, Outlook.com enforces SPF, DKIM and DMARC for domains sending more than 5,000 emails per day. Whether this covers Microsoft 365 tenants is not stated.
Gmail bulk senders (more than 5,000/day) need SPF and DKIM, a DMARC record (p=none allowed) and alignment. One-click unsubscribe does not apply to transactional mail.
DMARCbis is now RFC 9989 (Proposed Standard, May 2026), obsoleting RFC 7489 and RFC 9091.
RFC 8058 one-click unsubscribe uses an HTTPS POST, so link scanners that GET the URL do not trigger it.

CASL s.6(6)(d) exempts factual account notifications from the consent requirement only; the form and unsubscribe requirements still apply. Whether ClearCourse emails are commercial electronic messages is not assessed.
